# Statista

> Statista is a global statistics portal offering market data, consumer insights, industry studies, forecasts, and company dossiers across thousands of topics.

Statista aggregates statistics, survey results, reports, and infographics from thousands of sources, with coverage spanning industries, companies, countries, consumer behavior, digital markets, and public policy. Its platform is widely used for market research, benchmarking, trend analysis, and business intelligence.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://www.statista.com/): Main entry point to Statista's statistics, reports, and market research platform.
- [Topics](https://www.statista.com/topics/): Browse topic pages aggregating statistics, reports, and related insights by subject.
- [Markets](https://www.statista.com/markets/): Explore industry-focused market overviews, forecasts, and key performance indicators.
- [Companies & Products](https://www.statista.com/topics/companies-and-products/): Topic hub for company, brand, and product-related statistics and dossiers.
- [Countries & Regions](https://www.statista.com/topics/countries-and-regions/): Topic hub for country-level and regional statistics, rankings, and studies.
- [Statistics](https://www.statista.com/statistics/): Search and browse individual statistics across industries, markets, and geographies.
- [Reports](https://www.statista.com/study/): Access studies, dossiers, and report-style research publications.
- [Infographics](https://www.statista.com/chart/): Browse editorial infographics covering current events, markets, and social trends.

## Research Content Types
- [Statistics](https://www.statista.com/statistics/): Individual charts and datasets with source citations and downloadable visuals.
- [Studies & Reports](https://www.statista.com/study/): In-depth report pages covering industries, markets, and consumer trends.
- [Dossiers](https://www.statista.com/study/): Curated collections of statistics organized around a company, market, or topic.
- [Charts](https://www.statista.com/chart/): Editorial chart articles presenting data-driven stories and visual analysis.
- [Outlook](https://www.statista.com/outlook/): Forecast products for digital, consumer, mobility, and other markets.
- [Consumer Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/cmo/consumer-insights): Survey-based consumer behavior and preference data across countries and segments.
- [Company DB](https://www.statista.com/companies/): Company profiles and business data for firms across sectors.
- [Rankings](https://www.statista.com/rankings/): Lists and league tables comparing brands, companies, and institutions.

## Markets & Industry Coverage
- [Technology & Telecommunications](https://www.statista.com/markets/418/technology-telecommunications/): Market data and forecasts for software, hardware, telecom, and digital infrastructure.
- [Media](https://www.statista.com/markets/417/media/): Statistics on advertising, publishing, streaming, gaming, and entertainment industries.
- [E-Commerce](https://www.statista.com/markets/413/e-commerce/): Data on online retail, marketplaces, payments, and digital commerce trends.
- [Finance & Insurance](https://www.statista.com/markets/414/finance-insurance/): Coverage of banking, investing, payments, insurance, and financial services markets.
- [Health, Pharma & Medtech](https://www.statista.com/markets/412/health-pharma-medtech/): Statistics on healthcare systems, pharmaceuticals, biotech, and medical technology.
- [Consumer Goods & FMCG](https://www.statista.com/markets/415/consumer-goods-fmcg/): Market intelligence for food, beverages, household goods, and personal care.
- [Transportation & Logistics](https://www.statista.com/markets/419/transportation-logistics/): Data on automotive, aviation, shipping, rail, and supply chain sectors.
- [Economy & Politics](https://www.statista.com/markets/2535/economy-politics/): Economic indicators, public finance, labor markets, and political data.

## Topic Directories
- [Business, Consumer & Technology](https://www.statista.com/topics/business-consumer-technology/): Topic directory for business trends, consumer markets, and technology developments.
- [Economy & Politics](https://www.statista.com/topics/economy-politics/): Topic directory for macroeconomics, policy, elections, and government statistics.
- [Society](https://www.statista.com/topics/society/): Topic directory for demographics, education, crime, health, and social issues.
- [Countries & Regions](https://www.statista.com/topics/countries-and-regions/): Topic directory for national and regional data collections.
- [Companies & Products](https://www.statista.com/topics/companies-and-products/): Topic directory for brands, firms, products, and competitive landscapes.
- [Reports & Studies](https://www.statista.com/study/): Research publication directory for downloadable studies and dossiers.

## Outlook & Forecast Products
- [Market Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/): Forecasts and KPIs for digital and consumer markets worldwide.
- [eCommerce Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/dmo/ecommerce): Forecasts and benchmarks for online retail markets and categories.
- [Digital Market Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/dmo/): Data on digital markets such as advertising, fintech, and online services.
- [Consumer Market Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/cmo/): Forecasts for consumer goods and services markets across countries.
- [Mobility Market Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/mmo/): Market forecasts for mobility, transport, and automotive-related segments.
- [Consumer Insights](https://www.statista.com/outlook/cmo/consumer-insights): Survey-based insights into attitudes, usage, and purchase behavior.
- [Country Comparisons](https://www.statista.com/outlook/cmo/consumer-insights/worldwide): Cross-country consumer and market comparisons using Statista outlook products.

## Editorial & Data Journalism
- [Daily Data](https://www.statista.com/chart/): Data journalism hub featuring chart-based stories and current-event analysis.
- [Infographics](https://www.statista.com/infographic/): Visual explainers and infographic-style presentations of key statistics.
- [Chart Articles](https://www.statista.com/chart/): Short editorial pieces built around a single chart or data narrative.
- [Thematic Collections](https://www.statista.com/topics/): Topic pages linking related charts, reports, and statistics.
- [Rankings](https://www.statista.com/rankings/): Editorial and research rankings comparing brands, institutions, and markets.

## Company, Brand & Product Research
- [Companies Database](https://www.statista.com/companies/): Search company profiles, business facts, and related market intelligence.
- [Company Topics](https://www.statista.com/topics/companies-and-products/): Browse topic pages focused on major companies, brands, and products.
- [Brand Rankings](https://www.statista.com/rankings/): Compare brand performance and reputation across ranking publications.
- [Product & Category Statistics](https://www.statista.com/statistics/): Find product-level and category-level statistics across industries.
- [Dossiers on Companies](https://www.statista.com/study/): Access curated report collections centered on specific firms or sectors.

## Regional & Country Research
- [United States](https://www.statista.com/topics/772/united-states/): Topic page aggregating U.S. economic, consumer, and industry statistics.
- [Europe](https://www.statista.com/topics/3841/europe/): Topic page for European market, demographic, and policy-related data.
- [China](https://www.statista.com/topics/1416/china/): Topic page covering China's economy, consumers, and major industries.
- [India](https://www.statista.com/topics/1196/india/): Topic page for Indian market, population, and digital economy statistics.
- [Germany](https://www.statista.com/topics/442/germany/): Topic page with German economic, social, and industry indicators.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.statista.com/topics/3795/united-kingdom/): Topic page for U.K. business, consumer, and public sector data.
- [Worldwide](https://www.statista.com/topics/worldwide/): Global topic hub for international comparisons and worldwide statistics.

## Access, Accounts & Support
- [Pricing](https://www.statista.com/pricing/): Subscription plans and access options for individuals and organizations.
- [Corporate Solutions](https://www.statista.com/business/): Enterprise offerings for teams, research, and data access needs.
- [Research AI](https://www.statista.com/research-ai/): AI-assisted research features for discovering and summarizing Statista content.
- [Help Center](https://help.statista.com/): Support articles for accounts, billing, downloads, and platform usage.
- [Login](https://www.statista.com/login/): Sign in to access subscriptions, saved content, and account features.
- [Register](https://www.statista.com/register/): Create a Statista account for trial or subscription access.
